import nullable.Callbacks
fun invalid(): Int = Callbacks.bad { 1 }

import nullable.Callbacks
fun invalid(): Int = Callbacks.call({ a, b -> a + b }, 4)

import nullable.Callbacks
fun invalid(): Int = Callbacks.call({ value -> "wrong" }, 4)

import nullable.Callbacks
fun invalid() { Callbacks.event({ value -> value.length }, null) }
